<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the given molecule, removes a TBS protecting group, i.e., breaks an O‑Si bond and generates an aliphatic alcohol. In the forward direction this reaction forms a “t‑butyldimethylsilyl” group and breaks an “alcohol” (O‑H). Therefore we search the template catalog for templates that break an alcohol and form a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alcohol"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
